ideas.title: Mobile car wash at home or office (old town)
ideas.one_liner: Car owners pay you to wash and vacuum their vehicle in the driveway while they work or rest.
steps: Wash your own car and shoot photos
Flyer 15 driveways on one street
Offer $99/month twice-a-month plan for the first wash
Park the flyer on windshields politely
Book two cars per morning slot
Text before-and-after photos to the owner
Offer a twice-a-month plan to each client

pitfalls: Never wash on hot paint in direct sun
